confidence_notes: I ran three web searches. One gave the RBA rate. The other two covered Atlanta prices, and I did not use all five permitted price searches. Beer is anchored on Toast's March 2026 Atlanta median of about $6.86, and I rounded up slightly. Cocktail is based on Square's Atlanta bar averages of about $11-12, raised for restaurant pricing. Coffee ($4 from a secondary blog) and the inexpensive meal (about $15 from secondary sites citing Numbeo) were checked against the aggregators, then adjusted upward for 2026 prices. The secondary sources put a mid-range meal for two at about $50, which looks stale, so I used a higher holistic estimate. I found no reliable Atlanta wine-by-the-glass figure, so wine is set from its usual relationship to beer and cocktail prices in US restaurants. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search for accommodation prices or inspect any listings. Atlanta has few registered hostels, so the hostel anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Atlanta is a mid-to-large US Southern city. Its prices are somewhat below New York, San Francisco and Boston and in line with Dallas, Houston and Nashville. The accommodation estimates assume typical downtown and Midtown pricing in a mid-summer shoulder month.
